## Phase 2 Validation Complete

### Validation Results

**TypeScript**: ✅ Zero errors (`tsc --noEmit` and `bun run build` pass)
**Build**: ✅ Clean build (2059 modules, 472KB JS gzip 152KB)
**Phase 1 E2E**: ✅ 7/7 passed
**Phase 2 E2E**: ✅ 55/55 passed (new test suite created)
**Total E2E**: ✅ 62/62 passed

### Phase 2 Acceptance Criteria

| Criteria | Status |
|----------|--------|
| Issue list loads and displays real data from agentrack | ✅ PASS |
| Can create a new issue via the dialog | ✅ PASS |
| Can view issue's full details | ✅ PASS |
| Can change status, priority, assignee, title, description | ✅ PASS |
| Filters work (status, assignee, search) | ✅ PASS |
| Navigation between list and detail works | ✅ PASS |

### Test Coverage Created

**e2e/phase2-validation.spec.ts** — 55 E2E tests covering:

- **Backend API tests (29 tests)**:
  - GET /api/issues: 9 tests (array response, shape validation, status/assignee/search/tags/parentId filters, case-insensitive search)
  - POST /api/issues: 7 tests (minimal create, full create, validation errors for missing/empty/non-string title, default status/priority)
  - GET /api/issues/:id: 2 tests (full detail with timestamps, 404 error)
  - PATCH /api/issues/:id: 9 tests (update status/priority/assignee/title/description/tags, clear assignee, empty body 400, 404 error)
  - GET /api/users: 2 tests (array response, shape validation)

- **Frontend tests (26 tests)**:
  - Issues List Page: 6 tests (heading, issue rows, status badges, priority indicators, no console errors, empty state)
  - Filtering: 3 tests (search by title, status dropdown options, clear filters)
  - Create Issue Dialog: 4 tests (open dialog, form fields present, create issue flow, disabled submit)
  - Navigation: 3 tests (list→detail, detail→list back, 404 page)
  - Issue Detail Page: 10 tests (title/ID display, description, status badge, timestamps, tags, inline edit title/description, change status/priority/assignee via dropdown)

### Quality Issues Found

1. **Select.Value shows raw value instead of label** (LOW): The base-ui `Select.Value` component in the filter dropdowns displays the raw value (e.g., "all") instead of the user-friendly label (e.g., "All statuses"). This affects both the status and assignee filter dropdowns.

2. **No test data cleanup**: The agentrack API has no DELETE endpoint for issues, so test data accumulates across E2E test runs. Tests use unique titles to avoid collisions.

3. **No unit/integration tests**: The project currently has only E2E tests. Unit tests for API client, hooks, and components would improve test speed and catch regressions earlier.
